title: Bluestone Ore
description: This mod adds Bluestone Ore, which allows you to replace some or all of the items in your ore crafting with Bluestone.
body:
# Bluestone
This mod adds a completely new ore to the game, with distinct mechanics. The ore doesn't add new tools or armor. Instead, you can replace certain ores in crafting, such as iron, with the new ore. Bluestone has several tiers, which you'll need to upgrade in crafting to match the tier of one of the ores. To understand what this means, check out the screenshots.
## Tiers
Dust - Nothing

Pinch - Coal

Handful - Nothing

fistful - Redstone

Solid - Nothing

Raw - Gold

Ingot - Iron

Crystal - Diamond
### Crafting
To create higher-level Bluestone, combine 2x2 in the crafting grid. To obtain an ingot, you must roast raw Bluestone.
